title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
statement: Given the root of a binary tree, return the maximum path sum of any non-empty path. A path in a binary tree is a sequence of nodes where each pair of adjacent nodes in the sequence has an edge connecting them. A node can only appear in the sequence at most once. Note that the path does not need to pass through the root.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [1, 3000].

visibleExamples.explanation: The optimal path is 2 -> 1 -> 3 with a path sum of 2 + 1 + 3 = 6.
The optimal path is 2 -> 6 -> 9 -> -3 -> 2 with sum 16.

jsonFriendlyReason: The input parameter root is of type TreeNode, which requires a custom adapter for serialization.
